tools.description: Full-text search over Wikipedia articles. Returns matching articles ranked by relevance with titles, snippets, word counts, sizes, and timestamps. Paginated via integer offset; each page contains up to `limit` results. The response includes total_hits for the query and next_offset for advancing.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page (1-50).

offset.description: Pagination offset for fetching subsequent pages of results.

tools.name: wikipedia_api__search_articles

tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a single Wikipedia article including its text extract, categories, canonical URL, and metadata. Identify the article by page ID or title (at least one required). By default returns the introduction only; set full_extract to 'true' for the complete article text.

full_extract.description: Set to 'true' to get the full article text instead of just the introduction. Accepted values: 'true', 'false'.

pageid.description: Wikipedia page ID (numeric string, e.g. '23862'). Either pageid or title must be provided.

title.description: Wikipedia article title (e.g. 'Python (programming language)'). Either pageid or title must be provided.

tools.name: wikipedia_api__get_article_details

tools.description: List articles, subcategories, or files within a Wikipedia category. Paginated via opaque continuation tokens; the response includes next_continue for advancing. Returns an empty members array if the category has no members of the requested type.

category.description: Category name without the 'Category:' prefix (e.g. 'Science', 'Artificial intelligence').

continue.description: Continuation token for pagination, obtained from next_continue in a previous response.

limit.description: Number of members to return per page (1-50).

type.description: Type of members to return. Accepted values: 'page' for articles, 'subcat' for subcategories, 'file' for files.

tools.name: wikipedia_api__get_category_members
